confidenceRules.high: lesson title + description/keyPoints directly evidence the spec statement
confidenceRules.medium: content clearly within the statement's scope but partial, or inferred from adjacent evidence
confidenceRules.low: topical adjacency only; must be human-reviewed before any use

notes: Cognito chapter numbering is NOT the 4BI1 spec numbering (chapters 1-11 vs spec sections 1-5); refs were deliberately NOT used as join keys (P1 tracker gap 4; plan amendment A6).
Rows are grouped per lesson by confidence so a mixed lesson can carry a high bundle and a medium bundle separately.
lessonRef keys resolve to inventory rows in cognito-lessons.json (unique per shelf).
